podcast.title: Cameo on Last Man Standing (2015)
podcast.body: More than 17 years after *Home Improvement* ended, he made a cameo appearance on *Last Man Standing*, starring Tim Allen and Patricia Richardson. "Jonathan Taylor Thomas, and Patricia Richardson, made cameo appearances in an episode which also featured other nods to home improvement."

podcast.title: Academic Pursuits
podcast.body: After leaving Home Improvement, he graduated high school and attended Harvard University, where he studied philosophy and history. He spent his third year abroad at St. Andrews University in Scotland and later graduated from the Columbia University School of General Studies in 2010. "And though he did some minor gastroels here and there, the young actor graduated high school and then went to Harvard University where he studied philosophy and history and spent his third year abroad at St. Andrews University in Scotland."

podcast.title: Breakout Role on Home Improvement
podcast.body: His role as Randy Taylor, Tim Allen's cracking middle child, was his breakout role and established him as a 90s teen heartthrob. "Home improvement was the breakout role for Jonathan Taylor Thomas, the 90s teen heartthrob who went on to voice Young Simba in the Lion King."

podcast.title: Departure from Home Improvement
podcast.body: He left the show in its last season, stating he wanted to focus on school. While Tim Allen felt burned by this, claiming Thomas did films instead, for the most part, Thomas did focus on his studies. "Thomas left the show in the last season, saying he wanted to focus on school."
